name: Dubai Esports & Games Festival (GameExpo)
organizer: Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism (Dubai DET)
blurb: Dubai's citywide gaming festival; GameExpo at Dubai World Trade Centre is its flagship exhibition with esports tournaments and cosplay competitions.

editions.evidence: Official homepage live text: 'Dubai Esports and Games Festival (DEF) returns to Dubai from 9-25 April, 2027' / 'See you in 2027' (the page's own meta description is stale, still citing May-June 2026). GameExpo's specific Apr 23-25, 2027 sub-dates within that 9-25 April window are reported consistently by mid-east.info, IndexBox and gdnonline.com; no dedicated GameExpo sub-page with those exact dates was reachable directly on the official site to confirm firsthand.

notes: DEF is a ~17-day citywide festival (Apr 9-25, 2027); GameExpo is its flagship 3-day public exhibition at DWTC, which is what this entry tracks. The prior edition's GameExpo ran Jun 5-7, 2026 per the fixup note. No guest/talent lineup is announced yet for 2027.
